title: You don't have to carry this alone.
intro: Therapy in English and Mandarin for adults navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges. Culturally sensitive support to understand yourself and move forward at your own pace.
availability: Accepting new clients · NY, NJ & CA · Virtual · In-person NYC
welcomeTitle: Understand yourself. Make room for change.
welcomeBody: Trauma doesn't follow a timeline, and neither does healing. My work is rooted in the belief that every person carries within them the capacity for recovery — sometimes it just needs the right conditions to emerge.
welcomeBodyTwo: I take an individualized psychodynamic approach, incorporating CBT, EMDR, and Internal Family Systems (IFS) according to your needs. Our work can help you notice patterns, understand emotions, and build on your strengths, with care for your cultural context.

areas.title: Trauma & PTSD
areas.body: Finding safety in your own body again.

areas.title: Anxiety & Depression
areas.body: Support for worry, low mood, and self-doubt.

areas.title: Grief & Loss
areas.body: Making space for what you've had to let go.

testimonials.quote: You can bring your full range of emotions, questions, and uncertainties into our work.
Together, we can explore your story, recognize your strengths, and make room for a more authentic way of living.
